name: Paris Fury
bio: British woman who is best known for her marriage to boxing world champion Tyson Fury. She also is well known for her popular Instagram account, which features lifestyle, family, and fashion-related content. She released an autobiography in October 2021.

credits.title: Tyson Fury
credits.overview: Discover the man beneath the Fury in this feature length documentary from Lucy Wilcox. With exclusive access to Paris, Tyson and John Fury, this film charts the rise, fall and redemption of the one and only Gypsy King.
